title: Vertex buffers (Buffer + Mesh)
summary: Moves triangle positions into GPU vertex buffers via shareable Buffer and Mesh types. Draw now uses mesh.getVertexLayouts() at pipeline creation and draw(pass, mesh) each frame.
handoff_message: Review vertex buffer implementation: Buffer/Mesh sharing design, Draw API break, triangle migration.
cursor_notes: Breaking change: draw(pass, mesh) replaces draw(pass, vertexCount). Mesh lives in packages/belfast/src/core/Mesh.ts (not geometry/). See vertex-buffers-implementation.md.
